summary.text: Robert Reives is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 54 since 2014, serves as House Democratic Leader, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he is listed by the General Assembly as having served 6.5 terms.

paragraphs.text: Robert Reives holds a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and a law degree from the University of North Carolina School of Law, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as attorney.
Reives assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 29, 2014, and Ballotpedia reports he was elected House minority leader in 2020.
The General Assembly lists Chatham and Randolph counties for District 54.
The Democratic primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
